svg.title: Arena-Agents overall architecture
svg.desc: Layers: browser, FastAPI, GameOrchestrator, Runtime (Actor + Worker), Brain and World, plus the LLM adapters, the data directory and the scenario.
svg.text: The engine only provides a game-agnostic physical layer; the rules live in the scenario and an LLM moderator drives the game.
